name: 上班摸鱼
tagline: 摸鱼中 老板来了 下班！
note: 每张一个把字面意思画出来的视觉梗；视频里不写字，caption 后期统一加；截取对准笑点并定格。

stickers.caption: 摸鱼中
stickers.action: Sitting at an office desk, she reaches her hand straight into the computer monitor and pulls out a wriggling little fish, then hugs the fish happily against her cheek with a satisfied smile while the fish flops.

stickers.caption: 老板来了
stickers.action: Standing by her desk, she suddenly notices something off-screen, jolts with shock, then instantly freezes perfectly stiff and holds a small potted plant up in front of her face to hide, one eye peeking out beside the leaves with a sweat drop.

stickers.caption: 带薪发呆
stickers.action: Sitting at her desk with a blank dazed face, a small cute white ghost-like copy of herself floats up out of the top of her head and drifts lazily around, then gets sucked back into her head with a little pop.

stickers.caption: 下班！
stickers.action: Standing beside a wall clock; the clock hand snaps to six, she grabs her watermelon bag and blasts straight up out of the top of the frame like a little rocket, leaving a puff of cloud and a few sparkles behind.

stickers.caption: 收到！
stickers.action: Standing straight, she snaps into a crisp energetic salute with a big confident grin, a small sparkle pings next to her hand, then she gives a tiny firm nod.

stickers.caption: 开会中…
stickers.action: Sitting in a meeting chair, her head slowly droops as she dozes off, bobbing lower and lower, then she jolts awake with wide eyes and sits up straight pretending to pay attention.

stickers.caption: 先溜了
stickers.action: Standing by the desk, she glances left and right, then crouches onto a small skateboard and glides smoothly and quickly sideways completely out of the frame, leaving a tiny dust puff.

stickers.caption: 加班中…
stickers.action: Sitting at the computer late at night with tired dark eye bags and messy hair, typing like a zombie, her head slowly sinks and plops face-down onto the keyboard, a tiny soul wisp sighs out.
